mapper.select: select a.*,b.NAME as managerName from BIZ_CAD_PROJECT a left join BIZ_CAD_USER b on a.MANAGER = b.ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}
select a.*,b.NAME as managerName from BIZ_CAD_PROJECT a left join BIZ_CAD_USER b on a.MANAGER = b.ID where a.ID = #{prjId}

select a.*,b.NAME as stageName,b.INDEX as stageIndex,c.NAME as prjName from BIZ_CAD_SUB_ITEM a left join BIZ_CAD_STAGE b on a.STAGE_ID = b.ID left join BIZ_CAD_PROJECT c on a.PRJ_ID = c.ID where a.PRJ_ID = #{prjId} and a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE'
